title: Secret Kennedy-Khrushchev letters on destroying nuclear warheads

tellings.quote: thing. He starts secretly exchanging letters with with Kruef uh through Norman Cousins.

plain: In 1963 the American president John F. Kennedy is said to have started secretly exchanging letters with the Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev about destroying their nuclear warheads, passing them through a go-between named Norman Cousins. A researcher named Dan Sheehan tells this without naming a source, in a conversation linking Kennedy to the UFO secret. If true, it would mean Kennedy was quietly working toward ending the nuclear arms race behind his own government's back.
